root_cause: The orders seed renamed customer_id to cust_id, so stg_orders.sql selects a column that no longer exists.
evidence: DuckDB binder error: Referenced column "customer_id" not found in FROM clause!
patch:
--- a/dbt_project/models/staging/stg_orders.sql
+++ b/dbt_project/models/staging/stg_orders.sql
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 select
     order_id,
-    customer_id,
+    cust_id as customer_id,
     cast(order_date as date) as order_date,
     amount,
     status
 from {{ ref('orders') }}
